newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Rhone-Poulenc in US$50 mln Singapore plant.
newsitem.headline: Rhone-Poulenc in US$50 mln Singapore plant.

text.p: Pharmaceuticals firm Rhone-Poulenc Rorer Inc said on Monday it was investing US$50 million in a new chemical manufacturing plant in Singapore.
Construction of the new plant, which will include new laboratory facilities, will begin in September with manufacturing scheduled to start in 1999, Rhone-Poulenc Rorer (RPR) said in a statement.
The plant will make a key ingredient used in Lovenox/Clexane, anti-thrombosis product, which was RPR's top seller in 1996 with sales of more than US$400 million.

"The growth in sales of Lovenox/Clexane and projections for the future clearly indicate the need for additional manufacturing capability by 2000," said David Manwaring, general manager of RPR in Singapore.
The new plant provides additional capacity to RPR's existing facility near to Paris, France, the statement said.
